add_definitions(-DIDR_EXTRACTICON=101)
spec2def(mmcshext.dll mmcshext.spec)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# mmcshext.dll is all Rust (mmcshext-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mmcshext-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# mmcshext.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mmcshext-rust/src/mmcshext/mmcshext_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mmcshext_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mmcshext_shims PRIVATE uuid cpprt atl_classes liboleaut32 libole32 libshlwapi libcomctl32 libshell32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(mmcshext_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(mmcshext mmcshext-cargo mmcshext.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE mmcshext-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mmcshext_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
